headline: Content creator Ripon Mia arrested for rape in Netrokona
summary: The suspect was apprehended by RAB-14 in Mymensingh after remaining fugitive since the filing of the case on July 30.
details: Content creator Ripon Mia has been arrested in connection with the rape of a teenage girl in Netrokona.
A team from RAB-14 conducted a raid in the Achintapur area of Gauripur upazila, Mymensingh, on Thursday night to apprehend the suspect.
According to RAB, Ripon had been on the run since the case was filed. He was later handed over to Netrokona Sadar Police Station.
The incident occurred on July 30, when Ripon allegedly forcedly raped the victim. Local residents rushed to the scene after hearing the victim's screams, which caused the suspect to flee.
The victim's father subsequently filed a case at the Netrokona Sadar Police Station.
caption:
A well-known content creator arrested after allegedly raping a teenage girl.

Content creator Ripon Mia has been arrested in connection with the rape of a teenage girl in Netrokona.

A team from RAB-14 conducted a raid in the Achintapur area of Gauripur upazila, Mymensingh, on Thursday night to apprehend the suspect.

According to RAB, Ripon had been on the run since the case was filed. He was later handed over to Netrokona Sadar Police Station.

The incident occurred on July 30, when Ripon allegedly forcedly raped the victim. Local residents rushed to the scene after hearing the victim's screams, which caused the suspect to flee.

The victim's father subsequently filed a case at the Netrokona Sadar Police Station.

#Bangladesh #Netrokona #CrimeNews #Justice #RAB

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News
